items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 36:1
items.html: The place of the rooting of the second restriction is called by the name the belly of Ima. For Ima is the HaVaYaH of SAG: its Yod-Hey, which are the discernment of the upper AVI and the te'amim [cantillation marks] of SAG, have no part in the second restriction, and therefore they are filled with the filling of Yods; and its Vav-Hey, which are the discernment of YESHSUT, which is the discernment of the nekudot [vowel points] of SAG — therefore the Vav of this SAG has the filling of Aleph, which indicates the second restriction. For the line in its diagonal is the Parsa that separates between the GAR and the AHP: the upper Yod is the GAR that remain in the degree, and the lower Yod, which is like a Dalet, is the AHP that descended from the degree and outward. And there is the place of the impregnation of ZON, where they receive the sweetening of the quality of judgment in the quality of mercy, and therefore it is called the belly of Ima. And this is the secret of what was said, that the revelation of the female begins only from the Chazeh downward of AVI, that is, in the aforementioned YESHSUT, the secret of the Vav of SAG; but in the first three Partzufim — Atik, AA, and the upper AVI — there is no revelation of a female, since they are completely clean of the discernment of the second restriction, as explained. (Item 19).
